concerns.text: The exposure variable ‘AI‑companion usage (weekly frequency and session duration)’ is used as a proxy for the construct ‘parasocial relationship’. No validated measure of parasocial attachment is collected, so the construct validity of the primary predictor is questionable. Consider adding a direct, psychometrically validated parasocial relationship questionnaire (e.g., the Parasocial Interaction Scale) or providing a stronger justification that frequency/duration reliably capture the intended construct.
